speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Ovarian Carcinoma with Malignant Ascites and Pleural Effusion.

The clinical picture of a large ovarian mass causing shortness of breath, increased abdominal girth, and fatigue, combined with the absence of significant weight loss, strongly suggests advanced ovarian cancer with fluid accumulation rather than a benign process or infection.
